regressions.source: Timelock (sky PAS) executeBatch: removal of the executed operation id from the pending-id linked list (stor7/stor8) and deletion of its stored batch record (stor9[id])
regressions.issue: The operation id is no longer bound to a variable (_70). Mapping accesses print as stor7[concat(mem[0])] while mem[0] is reassigned between uses, so the same-looking key means the id on one line and the next pointer on the next. The record's fields are raw slots (stor[_72], stor[_87 + 1..4]) instead of stor9[_70].field_N. 11 more P4 lines (1 -> 12).
regressions.rule: After an encoding loop, keep the free-memory floor for the loop-advanced pointer. Then mem[0]/mem[32] stores cannot alias the hashed buffer, the hash binds to one variable, and mapping keys forward from mem[0] to their values (stor7[_70], stor9[_70].field_256).

improvements: P6 1 -> 0. executeBatch's three raw custom-error reverts are now 'revert with 0x5ead8eb5, _12, 4'. The operation-hash lengths now print as explicit expressions ('len -_10 + t - 32').
notes: The diff is 295 lines; I read all 4 changed functions. All 3 source loops are still whiles (25 whiles). getOperation (unknown279412c5) also lost two forwards to storage (stor9[_param1].field_768 -> mem[384], field_1024 -> mem[416]) in a return that was already raw. The P4 increase is all in executeBatch.
summary: One medium regression: in executeBatch's linked-list removal, the operation id is no longer bound, so keys print as a reassigned concat(mem[0]) and the record's fields as raw slots. The custom-error reverts improved.
